svg.text: Physics is not a procurement decision
Budgets physics sets, no acquisition changes
Voice carries G.114's 150 ms one-way ceiling; a strongly consistent LA→DC read costs ~37 ms round-trip in propagation alone,
before processing — regardless of what the contract says or which vendor sold the circuit. Non-negotiable inputs to architecture.
Exactly one purchase touches the floor
Where traffic ENTERS the network. DIA local breakout shortens the physical path by removing the geographic hairpin —
the same move as regional database placement. Distance is the only latency variable a buyer controls.
And it is only a latency fix
A DIA circuit satisfies none of the protection controls: unencrypted at the network layer (SC-8 open), no traffic classes (SC-5 open),
no telemetry (SI-4 open), no transport evidence (CA-7 open). The overlay and policy stack close the protection controls — never the
pipe. What transport selection itself closes is CP-8 (Telecommunications Services), through provider and path diversity.
place the primary at the regional center of gravity of its write consumers (arrange around the floor) · let SD-WAN attack the
addressable gap (the portion engineering can reach) · assign each workload the consistency class its geography can deliver.
Source: OrgComp Vol II Book 03 — Database Consolidation and Network Physics · Date Code 2026-07-29
